data.name: Sugam
data.gender_notes: Sugam is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'sugam', which means 'easy', 'smooth', 'sweet'. This name is often given to a child born during a peaceful and harmonious time, or to one who is expected to bring joy and happiness to his or her family. The name Sugam carries the meaning “Easy, smooth, sweet” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sugam usually hope their child will grow to embody easy, smooth, sweet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
